By induction, \(f(n)\) equals the number of \(1\)'s in the binary representation of \(n\): for \(n=2k+r\), \(r\in\{0,1\}\), we have \(f(n)=f(k)+r\), matching the binary digit count.

So we need the maximum popcount for \(m\le 2010\). Since \(2010<2048=2^{11}\), a popcount of \(11\) would require \(m=2047\), impossible. But
\[
1983=11110111111_2 \le 2010
\]
has \(10\) ones. Thus the maximum is \(10\).

\[
\boxed{10}
\]
